provenance: New independent dispatch selected model gpt-6.1-sol and reasoning_effort ultra; dispatch receipt in coordination/qualified_verifier_dispatches.json. These selected settings describe this review only, not historical authors or prior reviewers.
actual_checks: Read exact P/PSPACE prompt, both full prior functional-graph/affine-map attempts and entire original checker. Independently established existential elimination by inconsistent opposite-value requirements and universal elimination by checking both substitutions.
Verified empty/one-sided clause families, units, tautologies, n=0, inside-out prefix order and O(n^2) normalized2-clauses. Resolution preserves width2; no arbitrary-width closure is asserted.

Saved residual formulas for existential x contain only x and outer variables. The disjunction of false residual positive clauses chooses a legal move whenever the eliminated invariant holds; universal deletion guarantees both moves. Shared strategy circuits preserve prefix dependencies and polynomial output size.

Normal checker independently compared elimination to brute quantifier games and exhaustively played extracted strategies through two variables plus3000 seeded cases through eight. PASS and -O refusal retained; finite checks do not establish unrestricted PSPACE tractability.
primary_sources: Hubie Chen,cs/0607106v2,25July2006,primary abstract https://arxiv.org/abs/cs/0607106 explicitly credits quantified2SAT tractability to Aspvall-Plass-Tarjan1979. Complete elimination/strategy proof checked directly. Retained04_followup.json.
prior_work_distinction: Adds arbitrary-alternation quantified2CNF decision and compact winning strategies absent from both prior iteration analyses. The complete proof and bit/output accounting support a substantial tractable subclass without a class-equality claim.
scope_assessment: Fully quantified Boolean formulas with a 2-CNF matrix, arbitrary quantifier alternation and explicitly encoded variables are decidable in polynomial bit time. Inside-out width-preserving elimination also constructs polynomial-size circuits implementing existential winning strategies. This treats a substantial restricted PSPACE problem and does not decide P versus PSPACE.
execution_limits: All original attached checkers were read before execution. Normal and -O runs use isolated temporary copies; output logs retained. Finite diagnostics do not establish unrestricted or asymptotic claims. No imported massive computation, Lean or formal proof was run.
official_input_checks: Exact prompt wrapper bytes and Git blob SHA verified; metadata wrappers decoded and compared; canonical ID checked against active claim and 424 prior exclusions; all retained prior manuscript bytes matched wrappers.
scientific_limits: Independent mathematical/source review, not human review, formal certification, historical novelty certification or editorial acceptance.
